newsitem.title: UK: VCI in video deal with UK's Channel 4 film.
newsitem.headline: VCI in video deal with UK's Channel 4 film.

text.p: Publishing group VCI Plc has acquired the video retail rights to more than 20 UK feature films in a deal with Film Four Distributors, VCI said on Wednesday.
The package includes Mike Leigh's Oscar-nominated "Secrets and Lies", the acclaimed comedy "Brassed Off" and the screen adaptation of "Fever Pitch".
Film Four is a division of Channel Four Ltd.
The release schedule will begin in September and VCI has committed 1.5 million stg as a royalty guarantee.
Michael Grade, non-executive chairman of VCI, is the outgoing head of national television station Channel Four.
VCI, pursuing an aggressive growth strategy, last year signed a licensing deal with English soccer champions Manchester United and was reported to have considered a bid for the club.
VCI shares added 4p to 239p on Wednesaday.
